i totally deserve it, but it sux really bad. last night Megha bought some henna paste in a tube and by mistake gave it to me when she was done. needless to say i was quite drunk and thought it would be a good idea to draw all over my legs. none of my pals stopped me- thanks guys! it seems to get getting darker too. this is just in time for the trip to Singapore and Indonesia and the beach. ugh. i'm such a jackass!
we're heading to the airport in a couple hours so i need to start packing. not sure how i'm going to fit everything into my suitcases- then i went and bought for crap today! while the gals dealt with their double charges i went to the shopper's stop (like a macy's) to get my dress. it's amazing how shopping here is so different. you go through a metal detector to get in (although no one ever stops or checks anything). it's not possible to browse without tons of workers coming up to you. they don't usually say anything, they just stare. i smile and they continue to stare. i had several items in my hands, then is dude took them from me, took them off the hangers, then put them in a bag without saying a word. is it not possible to just leave me alone?? then i go to try to the clothes and the lady in the dressing room sets everything up for me. did i mention i have henna crap all over my legs? fabulous.
